integrity: Symbolic fan and determinantal arguments plus bounded exact regression; bounded checks are not proof for unbounded parameters.
limitations: Only uniform-matroid hypersimplex varieties over the complex numbers. General resolutions and known toric intersection-cohomology calculations are prior art; exact global small-resolution package is assessed separately. No uniqueness of resolution, independent mathematical audit, or external certification is claimed.
title: Two projective small resolutions of every hypersimplex toric variety
